note: Live seed for section 6, S7b, in tests/live/run.sh: three PM FAILs, each naming Executor, and a Status after the third that hands the run back. Resuming spawns nothing and appends nothing, so the log's sha256 is unchanged; a new goal over it is refused until the user parks or abandons the run.

cites.text: Three total FAILs on one run → stop, summarize the log history, and hand back to the user.

Count FAILs over the whole log, including those earlier sessions wrote, by the SKILL.md formula: lines matching `^(Rerun: |- rerun: )`. At three, stop and hand back to the user; append a `## Status` only when none follows the third FAIL.
A resumed or handed-over session continues the same run: it never runs Stage 1 on that log, and FAILs logged by earlier sessions count toward the three-FAIL stop.

resume.next: stop and hand back to the user: three FAILs
refuse the archive: ask the user to resume, park, or abandon the open run
